quest.title: Garcia's Paean: A Gift of Compatibility
quest.description: Mr. Garcia seems to be troubled by something...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x50000, Hero's Wit x1

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: Man, I don't understand it. Why do you have to use that weird machine to write some music score?

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: You see, in Sumeru City there are plenty of spices and jewelry on sale.

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: If none of them look good to you, I can help you make some accessories, too...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Well, about that... It was because of the Numbering Machine that I met Kaia.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: So I want to send her a gift that is related to the Numbering Machine, which is this "Arithmetic Music Score."

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: Heh, I don't get you. The Ms. Kaia you're talking about is a performer from a professional troupe. She has tons of good music scores to read.

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: What if she tosses your score away or completely forgets about it?

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Kaia would never do it, I am most certain.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: With all due respect, sir, it is beyond me to even think of a way to just hum the melody with this "music score" you created.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: If I may, sir, if you truly intend to create a... um... decent music score...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: We might as well pay a modest fee for hiring a professional in the theater to help...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: No. Negative. Not possible. That way the gift would mean nothing. I'll further modify the arithmetic formula and generate another music score!

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Besides, it will definitely take even longer... Let me think about it...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you two doing?

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Traveler, perfect timing! Mr. Garcia and I are trying to train the Numbering Machine into a fine composer.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: It might sound a bit perplexing. To put it simply, Mr. Garcia is trying to make the Numbering Machine generate music scores through certain equations.

choices.text: Can the Numbering Machine really do that?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: The Numbering Machine is a calculator by its nature. It is, of course, not capable of generating music scores on its own.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: After the Numbering Machine produces its results, Mr. Garcia has to use another arithmetic formula to translate everything into music notes.

choices.text: I'm having a headache!

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Precisely, Lutong! That is a very nice summary. It is exactly what I meant.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: So much for the explanation, Traveler! I am in a pressing need of your help. Please lend me a hand.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Mora and other payments will not be a problem. This is urgent!

choices.text: Are you in trouble?

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Negative, negative. It is an even direr situation!

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Do you happen to remember Kaia... I mean, Ms. Kaia? She is leaving Sumeru with her troupe today.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: I made a promise to her that I would present her a gift as a proper good-bye.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: And this "Arithmetic Music Score," which is calculated purely by algorithm, is my gift for Kaia.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: But... The score doesn't even look like it could be sung... There's no way I can present this as a gift to her!

choices.text: How about other gifts?

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: I'm afraid that won't work. If it were a commonplace gift, Kaia might... Apologies, I need a moment to calm down and collect my thoughts.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: A—Anyway, I need to further upgrade the Numbering Machine.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Traveler, please come visit Mr. Ahangar with me. I am certain that you will be of great help. Please lend me a hand.

choices.text: How about buying something instead?
Are you wanted by Fontaine?
I think I'm totally getting this.
Is the Numbering Machine that powerful?

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: I saw your sketches of the components.

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: They are not hard to make, but it'll surely take some time to reach your desired level of precision.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: How much time will it take? Can it be finished today?

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: Of course not! What do you think manufacturing components is like? Writing letters?

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: If it can't be done today, I definitely won't be able to upgrade the Numbering Machine...

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: What's with the hurry? Isn't your machine already finished?

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: I'll explain. We ran into... uh... some expected trouble...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Lutong tells everyone what happened...

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: So you fell in love with Ms. Kaia at first sight...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: What!? No! We are in a cooperation! Business partners! Goodness gracious, I am utterly...

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: Have you expressed your affection for Ms. Kaia?

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Affection? What...

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: So you never told her that you have a...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: I can assure that Mr. Garcia has mentioned it to her before.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: What!? Lutong! How did you know!?

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: My good sir, the excuse you used when you sent me away that time was simply too telling.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: That day in the café, too. Throughout your conversation with Ms. Kaia, you didn't even mention your Numbering Machine once.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Knowing you, I am certain that it was not any regular conversation.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Much appreciated, Lutong! Please, use that good memory of yours on something else.

choices.text: What did Ms. Kaia say?

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Sh—She said she would pay for the coffee the next day.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Aha.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Ohh...

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Can we please move on? The most pressing issue at the moment is components!

response.speaker: Ahangar
response.text: Ahem, since you've already paid, I'll do my best to finish these components as soon as possible.

response.speaker: Ahangar
response.text: But seriously, if you want a gift that makes Ms. Kaia happy, why don't you go and ask for some advice from a professional?

response.speaker: Ahangar
response.text: Like Sheikh Zubayr who runs the theater. He knows the likes and dislikes of his performance staff. He might know what gift you should give Kaia, too.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: That is a splendid idea. Mr. Garcia, please continue your discussion on the components with Mr. Ahangar.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: As for the Traveler and me, we shall pay a visit to the theater and ask Mr. Sheikh Zubayr for potential gift choices.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: As you often tell me, a backup plan is necessary for all pursuits, isn't it?

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Ah, thank you, Lutong.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: You're welcome, Mr. Garcia.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Let's hit the road, Traveler. I hope we will find... the right gift.

choices.text: What did she think?

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: Whew... Finally a break...

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: Hmm? You came for me? What do you need?

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: We would like to learn about Ms. Kaia...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Lutong asks the questions...

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: Kaia? Oh, right. She is a brilliant dancer.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: What she likes, huh? Hmm... If there has to be one... She is very fond of a snack called Candied Ajilenakh Nuts.

dialogues.speaker: Sheikh Zubayr
dialogues.text: But isn't Kaia about to leave Sumeru? She's been asking around to buy Candied Ajilenakh Nuts lately.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Candied Ajilenakh Nuts... Right, we transcribed a batch of recipes a few days ago when we were testing the capacity of the Numbering Machine. The recipe for Candied Ajilenakh Nuts was one of them.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Hmm... This sounds like a good idea. It's just that we still need someone who knows how to make them. Mr. Garcia and I are the least familiar with culinary arts...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've seen it before...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: But it could at least be a feasible backup plan. Let's return to Mr. Garcia and tell him about this.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: Judging from that look on your face... I assume you have some questions?

choices.text: Why don't you go with Kaia?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: I have proposed this idea to Mr. Garcia. I even negotiated with the troupe leader, and he was willing to hire me as their accountant.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: However, Mr. Garcia turned me down firmly, saying he had plenty of work yet to be finished and that the Numbering Machine still needed to be upgraded in various aspects.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Hehe, to be honest, that was my first time to question Mr. Garcia's judgment on important matters.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Enough about this. Let's bring the news to Mr. Garcia. I hope he won't wear out Mr. Ahangar's patience this time...

choices.text: Has Ms. Kaia told you anything?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Not that I'm aware of. Ever since a few days ago, whenever Mr. Garcia went on a date with Ms. Kaia, I would drink my coffee in the corner away from them and try my best to keep my eyes away.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Actually, all this time I've been hoping that one day, Mr. Garcia would suddenly say to me that he would postpone the development of the Numbering Machine and travel around with Ms. Kaia for some time.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: I would happily agree whether he gives me some compensation and temporarily sends me back to Liyue, or lets me continue keeping their accounts as usual.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: But each time, Mr. Garcia only pats on my shoulder and says: "Lutong, we need to continue discussing the mechanical structure."

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Lutong! You're finally back. Mr. Ahangar and I have been trying to find a way to reduce the time needed for component manufacturing, but there has been no progress so far. I'm running out of ideas...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: I assume this is good timing. The Traveler and I have just come up with a backup plan.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: The formula for transcribing music scores might be too complicated, but do you remember the recipe for Candied Ajilenakh Nuts that we transcribed?

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: We learned that Ms. Kaia is quite fond of a kind of snack called Candied Ajilenakh Nuts. Perhaps we could...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: ...Send the transcribed recipe along with the snack! Yes, of course, this could work...

dialogues.speaker: Ahangar
dialogues.text: I have neither the appropriate cooking equipment nor the culinary skills. Guess I can't be of much help.

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: I remember there's a pot we can use at Lambad's Tavern. Why don't we go there?

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Really? Great! Let's go! But how did you even manage to remember this...

dialogues.speaker: Lutong
dialogues.text: It is my duty, sir.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The group goes to Lambad's Tavern.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Splendid! We have both the ingredients and the pot ready. Hmm... Give me some time to recall the formula. Let's see... Where is my pen... Let me calculate this...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: This should do it! I've got the key data covered. Give me a few minutes to go over some other details...

choices.text: H—How did you manage to remember all of this?

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: I don't memorize everything. I just ran a brief mental calculation... It is not very complicated, given that I had it all calculated before.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: However, ingredient input varies between each group of data, but time for detailed calculation is a luxury at the moment...

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Traveler! You travel around the world. I'm certain that you have tasted quite some delicacies. I trust your intuition. I'll let you decide on the ingredient that's added in the maximum amount.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: The ingredients are: Ajilenakh Nuts, almonds, butter, and Sumeru Roses.

choices.text: Ajilenakh Nuts should be the biggest portion of the ingredients.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Hmm... Indeed. By the name of Candied Ajilenakh Nuts, the input of Ajilenakh Nuts should be maximized.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Lutong, add the ingredients according to the data. We must hurry.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Yes, sir.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The three of you start making Candied Ajilenakh Nuts...

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Is the number of Ajilenakh Nuts mildly... overwhelming? With this rate, I believe we can conveniently remove "candied" from the name "Candied Ajilenakh Nuts"...

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Well... At least it bares the portion of a proper meal...

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Anyway... Let's take these snacks and the recipe to Ms. Kaia now. I've made an appointment with her to meet at the usual place.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Oh, right, put this music score away, Lutong. I fear that I might hand it to Ms. Kaia accidentally...

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Wait, where is the score? Do you not have it, Lutong!?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: You had it with you the entire time, sir. If you don't have it, where else...

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Oh dear...

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Uh... sir?

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Go back to the café, now! I must have put the score on the table!

choices.text: Almonds should be the biggest portion of the ingredients.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: I am quite fond of the taste of almonds. Hmm... We shall proceed this way.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Lutong, add the ingredients according to the data. We must hurry.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Yes, sir.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The three of you start making Candied Ajilenakh Nuts...

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Sir, I'd prefer to call them "Honeyed Almonds."

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Well... We at least kept the sweet flavor of honey... They should have a... decent taste, I assume?

choices.text: Sumeru Roses should be the biggest portion of the ingredients.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Why are we using flowers in making honeyed sweets? This is perplexing...

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: That might explain why they're sold at such a high price.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Lutong, add the ingredients according to the data. We must hurry.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Yes, sir. Uh... Might I remind you that these ingredients are very expensive...

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Don't... don't worry. Keep it going.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: The three of you start making Candied Ajilenakh Nuts...

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: My goodness, would you look at that? If I didn't know these were edible sweets, I would think that they were an impressive bouquet for your proposal...

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Lutong! For once again, would you kindly channel that splendid power of imagination of yours elsewhere!?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: I believe this is perfectly opportune, sir.

choices.text: Do you know all this by heart?

talks.objective: Go back to the café, now!

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: What's the hurry? Did something happen to the machine again?

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: No, no. It is doing just fine. My apologies for keeping you waiting...

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: I just arrived. You said you were going to send me a gift. I have a gift for you, too.

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: Here, this bag of Candied Ajilenakh Nuts is for you. Having some sweets at work is a good way to relax both the body and mind.

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: Building that Numbering Machine is no easy task. You must take good care of yourself while working.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: Candied Ajilenakh Nuts? I... uh...

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: What's with the weird look? You don't like sweets? But I remember you told me that you like them.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: No, no. I love sweets. It's just... my gift for you is also...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Garcia takes out his Candied Ajilenakh Nuts and the recipe awkwardly...

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: Pfff... We have the same gift for each other, huh? Looks like we are more connected than we think.

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: Your Candied Ajilenakh Nuts sure have a different aroma. Oh, there's a recipe, too... Huh? Why is it written in numbers...

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: This is the Candied Ajilenakh Nut recipe I transcribed from the Numbering Machine's data! I converted all procedures and the amount of ingredients into accurate numbers.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: I—It's just like how I explained before. The accuracy is guaranteed! But I'm not really good at cooking, so these Candied Ajilenakh Nuts might taste very odd...

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: Don't worry. I'm sure I'll have a good time savoring these "calculated" Candied Ajilenakh Nuts. This is such an impressive gift.

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: Right, when I got here, there were many sheets of paper on this table, all covered in numbers like this recipe.

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: One of them had many codes on it. It looked like... a music score.

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, the handwriting on that paper looked just like yours.

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: That has nothing to do with me! I—It's probably some graffiti by some random drunkard...

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: Come on now, I have organized your scripts and transcribed texts for you. It was your handwriting, without a doubt.

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: I see. You have found another way to make a living before I leave, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Garcia
dialogues.text: A—Absolutely not. I—I would never write music scores for others in any circumstances!

dialogues.speaker: Kaia
dialogues.text: Is this score for me then?

choices.text: Has he... been in a romantic relationship before?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Please understand, Traveler. Mr. Garcia spends the substantial majority of his time in his studies, leaving himself little chance to socialize.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Maintaining such a heavy workload and having adept social skills at the same time would be impractical.

choices.text: Why don't you help him?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Well, I am always hoping that Mr. Garcia can find his true love.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: I believe that this heartfelt good wish qualifies for my salary undoubtedly.

response.speaker: Kaia
response.text: ...Come on now, enough with the sad expression. This time I won't be able to watch you calculating stuff... I'm leaving Sumeru.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: This is a... um... failed product. I wanted to create a music score for you, so I collected the music scores of most of your performances.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: I organized these scores and worked out a formula, hoping to create an all new score with my Numbering Machine.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: As you can see, regardless of how I changed the formula, it always resulted in a pile of... a pile of mess that was by no means music scores.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Please return this failed piece to me, I need to—

response.speaker: Kaia
response.text: This is not a "failed piece." This is your gift to me. I love it, and I'll keep it.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: But you can't even call this a music score! It's not even readable!

response.speaker: Kaia
response.text: That's only your perspective. I haven't given it a careful look yet, so maybe after I have... I'll be able to find something good about it.

response.speaker: Kaia
response.text: If you don't believe me, then come with me. During our trip, we can modify this score together.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Kaia, I am sorry, I...

response.speaker: Kaia
response.text: ...Still have a lot of ongoing studies, right? I knew you'd say that.

response.speaker: Kaia
response.text: Do you have a copy of this music score for yourself?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: I have made a copy of the score. Please keep the original handwritten score, Ms. Kaia.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Pardon me. When did you make the copy?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Sir, as an account keeper, I maintain a professional capability of transcribing texts.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Wait, how did you... no way...

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Sir, to be honest, I cannot recall it with sufficient clarity. We were occupied in work, I didn't allocate my attention otherwise.

response.speaker: Kaia
response.text: Lutong, how thoughtful of you! With you by his side, I have nothing to worry about.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: You flatter me, Ms. Kaia.

response.speaker: Kaia
response.text: Well, I should go back to the troupe now.

response.speaker: Kaia
response.text: Don't come see me off. Should you have any last minute thoughts and joined us, Lutong would be left alone in Sumeru.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: If that happened, I would find a way to return to Liyue, Ms. Kaia.

response.speaker: Kaia
response.text: I have no doubt in you, but... a certain someone might not give you that chance.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Kaia...

response.speaker: Kaia
response.text: Goodbye, Garcia.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: ...Goodbye.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Kaia turns and leaves...

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Sir, Ms. Kaia is well away from here by now.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Lutong, you said your instinct is always correct.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Do you think we'll meet Ms. Kaia again in the future?

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Of course, but considering her talent in the performing arts, I believe we might need to pay to see her performance next time.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Hahaha, that is a valid point indeed... Let's re-focus ourselves on the studies now, shall we? Or we'll probably be caught short financially for tickets by then...

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Here is your payment, Traveler. Thank you very much for not leaving our side throughout all this. Please take the Mora.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I hope your studies go well.

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Much appreciated. I hope so too.

response.speaker: Garcia
response.text: Lutong, uh... do you happen to have some Mora on you? I need to pay Mr. Ahangar...

response.speaker: Lutong
response.text: Please excuse us for now, Traveler. By the way, my intuition tells me that we will have abundant opportunities to work together in the future.

choices.text: Can't you give him some advice?
Kaia is doing all the work here...
